_meta.description: Crosstab count of region x segment decorated with an OVERLAY_DELTA_VS_MARGIN cell overlay that emits (cell - row_margin) per cell (additive sibling of OVERLAY_INDEX_VS_MARGIN / 01_crosstab_index_vs_margin.json). DELTA preserves the cell's units (counts) so renderers can surface absolute over/under-representation against the row average without dividing by zero. Supports every axis a Margin reference can target (row / column / grand) — this example uses row-axis. Buffered (host margin recomputation). Renderers centre diverging colour ramps on baseline = 0.
_meta.name: crosstab-delta-vs-margin
